# SoulOcta — Destiny Matrix calculator

> SoulOcta is a free Destiny Matrix chart calculator at https://soulocta.me. Enter a birth date and get a full 22-arcana octagram chart, free, no sign-up. The Destiny Matrix is self-reflection, created by Natalia Ladini in 2006. It is entertainment, not science, and not a prediction.

## Method
reduce22(n): digit-sum while n > 22; 0 becomes 22; 22 stays 22. A = day, B = month, C = digit-sum(year) reduced. Centre D = reduce22(A+B+C). F = A+B, G = B+C, H = C+D, I = D+A. Example: 14 June 1995 -> A14 B6 C6 centre 8 (Justice). Note: some sources define centre as reduce22(A+B+C+D); this site uses reduce22(A+B+C) and says so openly. On 29 November 2000 this site gives centre 6, the other method gives 3.
